com.sun.corba.se.spi.presentation.rmi

接口 PresentationManager.StubFactoryFactory

  • 所有已知实现类:
    StubFactoryFactoryBase, StubFactoryFactoryDynamicBase, StubFactoryFactoryProxyImpl, StubFactoryFactoryStaticImpl
    封闭接口:
    PresentationManager

    public static interface PresentationManager.StubFactoryFactory
    Creates StubFactory and Tie instances.

    • 方法详细资料

      • getStubName

        String getStubName(String className)
        Return the standard name of a stub (according to the RMI-IIOP specification and rmic). This is needed so that the name of a stub is known for standalone clients of the app server.

      • createStubFactory

        PresentationManager.StubFactory createStubFactory(String className,
                                                  boolean isIDLStub,
                                                  String remoteCodeBase,
                                                  Class expectedClass,
                                                  ClassLoader classLoader)
        Create a stub factory for stubs for the interface whose type is given by className. className may identify either an IDL interface or an RMI-IIOP interface.
        参数:
        className - The name of the remote interface as a Java class name.
        isIDLStub - True if className identifies an IDL stub, else false.
        remoteCodeBase - The CodeBase to use for loading Stub classes, if necessary (may be null or unused).
        expectedClass - The expected stub type (may be null or unused).
        classLoader - The classLoader to use (may be null).

      • getTie

        Tie getTie(Class cls)
        Return a Tie for the given class.

      • createsDynamicStubs

        boolean createsDynamicStubs()
        Return whether or not this StubFactoryFactory creates StubFactory instances that create dynamic stubs and ties. At the top level, true indicates that rmic -iiop is not needed for generating stubs or ties.
